mapper.select: SELECT c.*, u.username FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id
SELECT c.*, u.username FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.comment_id = #{commentId}
SELECT c.*, u.username FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.article_id = #{articleId} ORDER BY c.created_at
SELECT c.*, u.username FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (article_id, user_id, content) VALUES (#{articleId}, #{userId}, #{content})
INSERT INTO reports (comment_id, user_id, reason) VALUES (#{commentId}, #{userId}, #{reason})
